correctness.rationale: Exact leaf-to-root flux recursion; independent Poissonization gives b independent rare parent-overflow indicators. Every other overflow mechanism is controlled by an explicit \(O_t(b^{-1/4})\) union bound. The parent collision intensity tends to \(t^4/8\) and monotone Poissonization sandwich proves fixed-m convergence. All 50,549 finite exact sequential scenarios tested matched the recursion; finite tests were not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact probability and whole distribution of failures at the first nontrivial bottleneck on a canonical height-two hierarchy constitute a motivated statistic. The \(5/8\) exponent arises from simultaneous duplicated leaf preferences in one parent group, a structure not visible in overall birthday-collision thresholds or positive-density random-tree parking results. This predicts root overload at vanishing overall density and provides a checkable benchmark for hierarchical capacity models.
